defs.def: to drop down from a higher level to a lower level 落下；下落；掉落；跌落

ex.s: As night fell, panic set in.
ex.t: 夜幕降临时，恐慌袭来。

ex.s: It fell and crashed beside the cake.
ex.t: 它掉下来，砸在蛋糕旁边。

ex.s: The train moved on．The little boy was ____5____ awake on his mother's lap，but the woman dropped off to sleep．A moment later，he began to____6____the half-open window—one leg went over it．The man jumped up and ____7____the child just before he fell out．
ex.t: 火车继续前进。小男孩____5____醒着躺在母亲膝上，但女人睡着了。片刻之后，他开始____6____那扇半开的窗户——一条腿跨了过去。那人跳起来，在孩子____7____掉出窗外之前抓住了他。

ex.s: Airplanes seed threatening storm cells with a chemical to make small ice crystals fall as rain before they can grow into dangerous hailstones.
ex.t: 飞机向威胁性的风暴云团播撒一种化学物质，让小冰晶在长成危险冰雹前作为雨降落。

ex.s: Focused on balancing the bags, she didn’t notice her wallet falling out of her pocket.
ex.t: 她专注于平衡袋子，没注意到钱包从口袋里掉出来。

ex.s: The curtains were falling down, the lamps were falling down, It was a real _____34_____ .
ex.t: 窗帘正在落下，灯正在落下，这真是一个____34____。

ex.s: In this story, the spider falls a seventh time.
ex.t: 在这个故事里，蜘蛛第七次跌落。

ex.s: With water falling off it thick, brown hair, the bear stared back at me.
ex.t: 水从它浓密棕色的毛发上流下，那只熊回瞪着我。

defs.def: to suddenly stop standing 突然倒下；跌倒；倒塌

ex.s: Eric Brown, only three years old, knocked Henry down when he fell.
ex.t: 三岁的埃里克·布朗把亨利撞倒时，他自己也摔倒了。

ex.s: When he looked down, he   60   （accidental ）slipped and fell over the edge.
ex.t: 当他往下看时，他____60____（accidental）滑了一跤，从边上摔了下去。

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 小时候，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一座小镇。一天放学后，我在探索这座壮丽青山的绿林时，差点在一组台阶上摔倒。这些台阶会通向哪里？好奇心占了上风，因为我知道天很快就要黑了。我开始爬上那些奇怪而神秘的台阶。

ex.s: On a summer midnight, my parents and I had just___16___ a long flight and started to walk through the empty airport when I saw a passenger suddenly fall to the ground.
ex.t: 一个夏日的午夜，我和父母刚____16____长途飞行，开始穿过空荡荡的机场，这时我看见一名乘客突然倒在地上。

ex.s: Suddenly, Paris fell to the ground, “Paris’s eye rolled back,” Taylor says.
ex.t: 突然，帕里斯倒在地上，“帕里斯的眼睛翻了过去，”泰勒说。

ex.s: It reminds her that children don’t enter life  47  to take risks or unwilling to  48  again when they fall down.
ex.t: 这提醒她，孩子进入生活时并不____47____去冒险，也不是在跌倒后不愿再次____48____。

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 现在我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有怀疑和遗憾。但我们仍必须攀登，梦想山顶有什么。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Alistair pushed himself towards the finish line in the burning heat, but as he came round the corner, he saw his brother about to fall onto the track.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔在酷热中朝终点线奋力前进，但当他转过弯道时，看到哥哥即将摔倒在跑道上。

defs.def: to hang down 下垂；低垂
to slope downwards 向下倾斜
to decrease in amount, number or strength （数量）减少，下降；（强度）减小

ex.s: However, while some of her classmates edged ahead, others actually fell behind.
ex.t: 然而，当她的一些同学赶超时，另一些实际上落后了。

ex.s: In the Sierra high country, the number of big trees has fallen by more than 55 percent; in parts of southern California the decline was nearly 75 percent.
ex.t: 在内华达山脉高山区，大树的数量下降了超过55%；在南加州部分地区，下降幅度接近75%。

ex.s: Statistics show that the average number of births per woman has fallen from 4.9 in the early 1960s to 2.5 nowadays.
ex.t: 统计显示，女性平均生育数已从1960年代初的4.9降至如今的2.5。

ex.s: 38   “I think a point that many people lose sight of is how easy it can be to fall behind schedule,” says graduate student Amanda Bindman.
ex.t: 38 “我认为许多人忽视的一点是，落后于计划是多么容易，”研究生阿曼达·宾德曼说。

ex.s: So even if your own efforts at humor fall short, you might be freeing the long kept humor in others.
ex.t: 所以即使你自己的幽默努力不够，你也可能释放出他人长期压抑的幽默。

ex.s: In the north of India, the population is booming due to high birth rates, but in the south, where most economic development is taking place, birth rate is falling rapidly.
ex.t: 在印度北部，由于高出生率人口正在激增，但在经济发展主要发生的南部，出生率正在迅速下降。

ex.s: Road accidents, which had fallen for years, are now rising sharply.
ex.t: 多年来一直在下降的交通事故，现在正急剧上升。

ex.s: Second, if other factors such as technology remain constant, economic growth and material expectations will fall well below recent standards and this could invite trouble.
ex.t: 其次，如果技术等其它因素保持不变，经济增长和物质期望将远低于近期标准，这可能招致麻烦。

ex.s: Sadly, human activity is the main reason why the number of monarch butterflies is falling.
ex.t: 遗憾的是，人类活动是帝王蝶数量下降的主要原因。

ex.s: For this reason, the number of monarch butterflies is falling.
ex.t: 出于这个原因，帝王蝶的数量正在下降。

defs.def: to be defeated or captured 被打败；沦陷；失守
to die in battle; to be shot 阵亡；被击毙
to pass into a particular state; to begin to be sth 进入（某状态）；开始变成（某事物）

ex.s: Eventually, she fell asleep.
ex.t: 最终，她睡着了。

ex.s: They both fell   58   （sleep）while watching TV.
ex.t: 他们俩看电视时都____58____（sleep）睡着了。

ex.s: Comparing yourself with someone who is outperforming you could result in feelings of envy if you focus on the things they have and you don’t, or it can be energizing and inspiring if you use these comparisons as a source of motivation, for example, “If they can achieve that, so can I.” Comparing yourself with someone who is doing worse than you could result in fear and worry if you think about how you could fall into similar circumstances, or it can draw out feelings of gratitude and appreciation if you use that comparison to broaden your views — for example, “Wow, things could be much worse; I’m doing great.”
ex.t: 把自己和表现优于你的人比较，如果你关注他们拥有而你没有的东西，可能会产生嫉妒；但如果你把这些比较当作动力来源，也可能令人振奋，比如“如果他们能做到，我也能”。把自己和不如你的人比较，如果你想到自己也可能陷入类似处境，可能会产生恐惧和担忧；但如果你用那种比较来拓宽视野，也可能引发感恩和感激——比如“哇，情况可能更糟；我做得很好。”

ex.s: Changing levels of body chemicals called hormones not only make teenagers’ bodies develop adult characteristics, but also make it hard for teenagers to fall asleep before 11 pm.
ex.t: 被称为激素的体内化学物质水平的变化，不仅让青少年的身体发育出成人特征，也让他们很难在晚上11点前入睡。

ex.s: It prevents people who are cut off from society falling victim to cheaters.
ex.t: 它防止那些与社会隔绝的人沦为骗子的受害者。

ex.s: Last year the Foundation reported that nearly 60% of 7- to 12-year-olds said they felt tired during the day, and 15% said they had fallen asleep at school.
ex.t: 去年该基金会报告称，近60%的7至12岁儿童说他们白天感到疲倦，15%说他们在学校睡着了。

ex.s: In Peru, local farmers around a mountain with a glacier that has already fallen victim to climate change have begun painting the entire mountain peak white in the hope that the added reflectiveness will restore the life-giving ice.
ex.t: 在秘鲁，一座冰川已经沦为气候变化的受害者，周围当地的农民开始把整个山峰漆成白色，希望增加的反光性能恢复那赋予生命的冰。

ex.s: He poured water from a bottle into his hand and offered it to my dogs. ______50______, I began to fall for him.
ex.t: 他用水瓶里的水倒在手上，递给我的狗。____50____，我开始爱上他。

defs.def: to come quickly and suddenly 突然来到；突然出现
to happen or take place 发生
to move in a particular direction or come in a particular position （向某方向）移动；落（在某位置上）

ex.s: My parents urged me to get out of this so-called unhealthy habit, but their repeated requests fell on deaf ears.
ex.t: 我父母敦促我改掉这个所谓不健康的习惯，但他们再三的请求都未被理睬。

ex.s: Recently，I took a trip home by train．I got a seat opposite a middle-aged man with sharp eyes，who kept____1____a young woman in a window seat with a little boy on her lap．The woman's eye fell on the man's face，and she immediately looked down and____2____her scarf．
ex.t: 最近我坐火车回老家。我对面坐着一位目光锐利的中年男子，他一直在____1____盯着窗边座位上抱着小孩的年轻女士看。那位女士的目光落在男士脸上，她立刻低下头并____2____围紧了围巾。

ex.s: Any combination of movies and crime novels that falls below the budget line is affordable.
ex.t: 任何电影和犯罪小说的组合，只要落在预算线以下就是负担得起的。

defs.def: to belong to a particular class, group or area of responsibility 属于（某类、群体、责任范围）

ex.s: I think my home falls into that category.
ex.t: 我认为我的家属于那一类。

defs.def: to be in very bad condition so that parts are breaking off 破碎；破裂

ex.s: Over time, the bags fall apart   6   countless tiny pieces, and fish cam accidentally eat some of them.
ex.t: 随着时间的推移，这些袋子____6____破碎成无数小碎片，鱼可能会不小心吃到一些。

defs.def: to have so many problems that it is no longer possible to exist or function 破裂；崩溃

ex.s: Because we’re human, we often fall flat.
ex.t: 因为我们是人，我们常常失败（达不到预期效果）。

defs.def: to move or turn back 后退；撤退；退却

ex.s: I don’t want to have nothing else to fall back on when I can’t model my more.”
ex.t: 当我不做模特时，我不想没有任何可以依靠（的退路）。

ex.s: A bright red cloud enveloped the animal, and to Mac's relief, it fell back, shaking its head.
ex.t: 一团鲜红的云笼罩了那只动物，令麦克宽慰的是，它摇着头后退了。

defs.def: to decrease in value or amount （价值）降低；（数量）减少

ex.s: It will fall out of use some day.
ex.t: 有一天它会不再被使用。

defs.def: to attack or take hold of sb/sth with a lot of energy and enthusiasm 袭击；向 … 进攻；扑向；抓住
to be the responsibility of sb （责任）落在 … 身上；由 … 负担
to become loose and drop 掉落；脱落

ex.s: “I was turning the page to get ready for the next page, but the draft wind from the turn caused the spare pages to fall off the stand,” Mr Titterton said, “Luckily I was able to catch them and put them back.”
ex.t: “我当时正翻页准备下一页，但翻页带起的气流让多余的几页从谱架上掉下来，”蒂特顿先生说，“幸好我接住了它们并放回去。”

ex.s: His strange habit makes sense when you consider that he’s an environmental scientist who studies how to reduce litter, including things that fall off garbage trucks as they drive down the road.
ex.t: 他奇怪的习惯在你想到他是一位研究如何减少垃圾的环境科学家时就有道理了，包括研究那些在垃圾车沿路行驶时从车上掉落的东西。

ex.s: Stop things falling off trucks.
ex.t: 阻止东西从卡车上掉落。

defs.def: if soldiers fall out, they leave their lines and move away 原地解散；离开队列
an act of falling 落下；下落；跌落；掉落

ex.s: Galileo was not merely ambitious when he dropped objects of varying weights from the Leaning Tower at Pisa and timed their fall to the ground.
ex.t: 伽利略从比萨斜塔扔下不同重量的物体并测量它们落地的时间，这并非仅仅是野心。

ex.s: And by understanding how we slipped, we can avoid falling in the future.
ex.t: 通过理解我们是如何滑倒的，我们可以在未来避免摔倒。

ex.s: Catching falling objects.
ex.t: 接住下落的物体。

defs.def: an amount of snow, rocks, etc. that falls or has fallen （雪、岩石等的）降落

ex.s: The path to Dawson was covered with thirty feet of wet snow that could fall without warming.
ex.t: 通往道森的路被三十英尺厚的湿雪覆盖，这些雪在不升温的情况下可能会降落。

ex.s: Microplastics have become a common source of pollution across the Earth — they have settled in the deep sea and on the Himalayas, stuck inside volcanic rocks, filled the stomachs of seabirds and even fallen in fresh Antarctic snow.
ex.t: 微塑料已成为地球常见的污染源——它们沉积在深海和喜马拉雅山上，嵌在火山岩中，填满海鸟的胃，甚至落在南极的新鲜雪中。

defs.def: the way in which sth falls or happens 下落；发生
a large amount of water falling down from a height 尤用于名称

ex.s: Or Africa’s Victoria Falls.
ex.t: 或者非洲的维多利亚瀑布。

ex.s: That’s one of the countries 4__________ you can visit the famous Victoria Falls.
ex.t: 那是你可以游览著名的维多利亚瀑布的4__________国家之一。

defs.def: 在 2009 年的秋天

ex.s: One fall，my wife Elli and I had a single goal:to photograph polar bears.
ex.t: 有一年秋天，我和妻子埃利有一个共同目标：拍摄北极熊。

ex.s: Who is eligible: Students aged 15-29, returning to school in the fall.
ex.t: 资格：15-29岁、在秋季返校的学生。

defs.def: a decrease in size, number, rate or level （大小）减小；（数量）减少；（比率、水平）降低

ex.s: A big fall in crime rates.
ex.t: 犯罪率的大幅下降。

defs.def: a loss of political, economic, etc. power or success; the loss or defeat of a city, country, etc. in war （政权的）垮台；（经济的）崩溃；（城市、国家的）沦陷，灭亡

ex.s: The rise and fall of a city.
ex.t: 一座城市的兴衰。

ex.s: The Rise and Fall of Jazz.
ex.t: 爵士乐的兴衰。

defs.def: a situation in which a person, an organization, etc. loses the respect of other people because they have done sth wrong （威信的）骤降
the occasion when Adam and Eve did not obey God and had to leave the Garden of Eden 人类堕落（指亚当和夏娃违背上帝意旨而被迫离开伊甸园）
